rationale: The agent did not follow policy or fully complete the user’s request. It failed to authenticate the user before taking action, did not confirm with the user prior to performing an order-changing write (initiating the return), and provided specific refund details (Mastercard ending in 2478) that are not supported by visible tool outputs. Additionally, it did not address the first part of the request about how many t-shirt options are available—no relevant query or answer was provided. Therefore, the interaction violates multiple required steps (authentication, confirmation, accurate and supported information) and is incomplete.
